Class WatchlistController

java.lang.Object
app.watchlist.WatchlistController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/me/watchlist") public class WatchlistController extends Object
Authenticated watchlist endpoints; ownership comes only from the token subject.

    • add

      @PutMapping("/{symbol}") public WatchlistRepository.Entry add(@AuthenticationPrincipal org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt jwt, @PathVariable String symbol)
      Saves a stock to the caller's watchlist.
      Parameters:
      jwt - verified access token
      symbol - seeded stock symbol
      Returns:
      saved stock, preserving its original timestamp on duplicate requests
      Throws:
      org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException - if the stock is unknown
      UserNotFoundException - if the caller has no business profile

    • remove

      @DeleteMapping("/{symbol}") @ResponseStatus(NO_CONTENT) public void remove(@AuthenticationPrincipal org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt jwt, @PathVariable String symbol)
      Removes a stock from the caller's watchlist.
      Parameters:
      jwt - verified access token
      symbol - stock symbol; missing entries succeed
